prompt: A ball is dropped from a balcony. Its height in meters after $t$ seconds is $h = 45 - 5t^2$. After how many seconds does it hit the ground ($h = 0$)?

hints.text: $t^2 = 9$ gives $t = 3$ (time can't be negative). It lands after $3$ seconds.

explanation: Time must be positive: the ball lands after $3$ seconds.

alternativeExplanations.title: Second-by-second table
steps: t = 3: h = 45 − 45 = 0 — the ball reaches the ground at 3 seconds.
Notice it falls faster each second: that is the parabola at work.

alternativeExplanations.title: Two roots, one real landing
steps: t² = 9 has two answers, 3 and −3 — every square does.
But t = −3 would mean 3 seconds BEFORE the drop, which makes no sense here.
